  "memo":"R08 holds: five accounts share the shipping address. The household exception does not apply despite home delivery, because the address is newly registered and the count exceeds the exception's limit. Linkage is the only adverse family; no Context condition holds and no earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) initially requires id_check, which passed. All required checks are therefore complete, making clear mandatory under §5.3(a). Shared housing remains the strongest benign explanation. No installments were due, so repayment intent cannot support an adverse action. The order has already shipped; no further check is needed."
